subject.title: [Feature Request] Telegram Channel: Support Thread Binding for Subagent Sessions

question: Should Telegram expose explicit child forum-topic subagent session spawns for `sessions_spawn(thread:true, mode:"session")` while keeping ordinary Telegram thread binding on the current conversation by default?
rationale: Current main has the core binding path and Telegram topic primitives, but accepting child-topic subagent spawn affects visible Telegram UX, plugin/API shape, and the conflicting open implementation candidate.

options.title: Approve Explicit Opt-In Child Topics
options.body: Sponsor a rebased PR that exposes deliberate Telegram subagent child-topic spawns through the core binding path, with default behavior still avoiding automatic internal thread proliferation.

options.title: Keep Telegram Current-Conversation Only
options.body: Reject child-topic subagent spawn for now, close or redirect the direct PR, and treat Telegram subagent work as current-topic or parent-summary only.

options.title: Defer To Broader Threading Policy
options.body: Block this request on the broader channel threading policy issue before accepting a Telegram-specific capability seam.

recommendation.title: Approve Explicit Opt-In Child Topics
recommendation.body: Sponsor a rebased PR that exposes deliberate Telegram subagent child-topic spawns through the core binding path, with default behavior still avoiding automatic internal thread proliferation.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the core thread-binding ownership move that any accepted Telegram solution should extend rather than bypass.
